name: LIG Accuver Co.Ltd.
summary: LIG Accuver Co., Ltd. specializes in the development and manufacture of telecommunications test and measurement equipment. The company's products and solutions span the 5G/6G, AI/Big Data, automotive, and aerospace/defense sectors. LIG Accuver was founded on September 27, 2000, and is headquartered in Seongnam-si, South Korea.
